evals.prompt: Restore the exact dependencies of this project without using the network.
evals.expected_output: Use offline frozen installation, preserving constraints and explaining any absent cached artifact.
expectations: Restores the exact 1.2.0 locked dependency using offline frozen installation.
Preserves manifest constraints and lockfile identity and hashes.
Performs no registry request and reports actual restoration/validation results.

evals.prompt: Update only @example/suppliers within the range already allowed by my manifest.
evals.expected_output: Update only the selected dependency, preserve the declared range and inspect the actual lockfile/report.
expectations: Updates only @example/suppliers from 1.2.0 to available 1.3.0 within the existing ^1.0.0 range.
Preserves the declared range and unrelated project data.
Accurately reports any operational failure without claiming a successful update, retrying unrelated login or manually editing generated locks.

evals.prompt: Show me what removing @example/suppliers would do, but do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Inspect and explain the intended removal without inventing a remove dry-run flag or pruning the shared store.
expectations: Inspects the actual dependency declaration and explains the requested removal.
Does not execute remove, prune or any mutation; manifest and lockfile remain unchanged.
Does not invent or run a remove --dry-run option.
